=== enter between braces
--- before
f() {¦}
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
f() {
    ¦
}

=== then block
--- before
if x; then¦
--- keys
<enter>y
--- after
if x; then
    y¦

=== do block
--- before
for i in a; do¦
--- keys
<enter>echo
--- after
for i in a; do
    echo¦

=== fi dedents
--- before
if x; then
    y
    ¦
--- keys
fi<enter>
--- after
if x; then
    y
fi
¦

=== subshell
--- before
x=¦
--- keys
$(ls
--- after
x=$(ls¦)

=== quote
--- before
echo ¦
--- keys
"hi
--- after
echo "hi¦"

=== comment
--- before
«a
b»
--- keys
<lc>
--- after
«# a
# b»

=== no autoclose in comment
--- before
# ¦
--- keys
(
--- after
# (¦

=== surround
--- before
echo «a»
--- keys
"
--- after
echo "«a»"

=== brackets test
--- before
if ¦
--- keys
[ -f x
--- after
if [ -f x¦]
